name: forecast
description: Provides APIs for creating and managing Amazon Forecast resources.

subcommands.name: create-auto-predictor
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Forecast predictor.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Forecast dataset.

subcommands.name: create-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Creates a dataset group, which holds a collection of related datasets.

subcommands.name: create-dataset-import-job
subcommands.description: Imports your training data to an Amazon Forecast dataset.

subcommands.name: create-explainability
subcommands.description: Explainability is only available for Forecasts and Predictors generated from an AutoPredictor (CreateAutoPredictor) Creates an Amazon Forecast Explainability.

subcommands.name: create-explainability-export
subcommands.description: Exports an Explainability resource created by the CreateExplainability operation.

subcommands.name: create-forecast
subcommands.description: Creates a forecast for each item in the TARGET_TIME_SERIES dataset that was used to train the predictor.

subcommands.name: create-forecast-export-job
subcommands.description: Exports a forecast created by the CreateForecast operation to your Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket.

subcommands.name: create-monitor
subcommands.description: Creates a predictor monitor resource for an existing auto predictor.

subcommands.name: create-predictor
subcommands.description: This operation creates a legacy predictor that does not include all the predictor functionalities provided by Amazon Forecast.

subcommands.name: create-predictor-backtest-export-job
subcommands.description: Exports backtest forecasts and accuracy metrics generated by the CreateAutoPredictor or CreatePredictor operations.

subcommands.name: create-what-if-analysis
subcommands.description: What-if analysis is a scenario modeling technique where you make a hypothetical change to a time series and compare the forecasts generated by these changes against the baseline, unchanged time series.

subcommands.name: create-what-if-forecast
subcommands.description: A what-if forecast is a forecast that is created from a modified version of the baseline forecast.

subcommands.name: create-what-if-forecast-export
subcommands.description: Exports a forecast created by the CreateWhatIfForecast operation to your Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Forecast dataset that was created using the CreateDataset operation.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a dataset group created using the CreateDatasetGroup operation.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset-import-job
subcommands.description: Deletes a dataset import job created using the CreateDatasetImportJob operation.

subcommands.name: delete-explainability
subcommands.description: Deletes an Explainability resource.

subcommands.name: delete-explainability-export
subcommands.description: Deletes an Explainability export.

subcommands.name: delete-forecast
subcommands.description: Deletes a forecast created using the CreateForecast operation.

subcommands.name: delete-forecast-export-job
subcommands.description: Deletes a forecast export job created using the CreateForecastExportJob operation.

subcommands.name: delete-monitor
subcommands.description: Deletes a monitor resource.

subcommands.name: delete-predictor
subcommands.description: Deletes a predictor created using the DescribePredictor or CreatePredictor operations.

subcommands.name: delete-predictor-backtest-export-job
subcommands.description: Deletes a predictor backtest export job.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-tree
subcommands.description: Deletes an entire resource tree.

subcommands.name: delete-what-if-analysis
subcommands.description: Deletes a what-if analysis created using the CreateWhatIfAnalysis operation.

subcommands.name: delete-what-if-forecast
subcommands.description: Deletes a what-if forecast created using the CreateWhatIfForecast operation.

subcommands.name: delete-what-if-forecast-export
subcommands.description: Deletes a what-if forecast export created using the CreateWhatIfForecastExport operation.

subcommands.name: describe-auto-predictor
subcommands.description: Describes a predictor created using the CreateAutoPredictor operation.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset
subcommands.description: Describes an Amazon Forecast dataset created using the CreateDataset operation.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Describes a dataset group created using the CreateDatasetGroup operation.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset-import-job
subcommands.description: Describes a dataset import job created using the CreateDatasetImportJob operation.

subcommands.name: describe-explainability
subcommands.description: Describes an Explainability resource created using the CreateExplainability operation.

subcommands.name: describe-explainability-export
subcommands.description: Describes an Explainability export created using the CreateExplainabilityExport operation.

subcommands.name: describe-forecast
subcommands.description: Describes a forecast created using the CreateForecast operation.

subcommands.name: describe-forecast-export-job
subcommands.description: Describes a forecast export job created using the CreateForecastExportJob operation.

subcommands.name: describe-monitor
subcommands.description: Describes a monitor resource.

subcommands.name: describe-predictor
subcommands.description: This operation is only valid for legacy predictors created with CreatePredictor.

subcommands.name: describe-predictor-backtest-export-job
subcommands.description: Describes a predictor backtest export job created using the CreatePredictorBacktestExportJob operation.

subcommands.name: describe-what-if-analysis
subcommands.description: Describes the what-if analysis created using the CreateWhatIfAnalysis operation.

subcommands.name: describe-what-if-forecast
subcommands.description: Describes the what-if forecast created using the CreateWhatIfForecast operation.

subcommands.name: describe-what-if-forecast-export
subcommands.description: Describes the what-if forecast export created using the CreateWhatIfForecastExport operation.

subcommands.name: get-accuracy-metrics
subcommands.description: Provides metrics on the accuracy of the models that were trained by the CreatePredictor operation.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of dataset groups created using the CreateDatasetGroup operation.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-import-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of dataset import jobs created using the CreateDatasetImportJob operation.

subcommands.name: list-datasets
subcommands.description: Returns a list of datasets created using the CreateDataset operation.

subcommands.name: list-explainabilities
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Explainability resources created using the CreateExplainability operation.

subcommands.name: list-explainability-exports
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Explainability exports created using the CreateExplainabilityExport operation.

subcommands.name: list-forecast-export-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of forecast export jobs created using the CreateForecastExportJob operation.

subcommands.name: list-forecasts
subcommands.description: Returns a list of forecasts created using the CreateForecast operation.

subcommands.name: list-monitor-evaluations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the monitoring evaluation results and predictor events collected by the monitor resource during different windows of time.

subcommands.name: list-monitors
subcommands.description: Returns a list of monitors created with the CreateMonitor operation and CreateAutoPredictor operation.

subcommands.name: list-predictor-backtest-export-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of predictor backtest export jobs created using the CreatePredictorBacktestExportJob operation.

subcommands.name: list-predictors
subcommands.description: Returns a list of predictors created using the CreateAutoPredictor or CreatePredictor operations.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for an Amazon Forecast resource.

subcommands.name: list-what-if-analyses
subcommands.description: Returns a list of what-if analyses created using the CreateWhatIfAnalysis operation.

subcommands.name: list-what-if-forecast-exports
subcommands.description: Returns a list of what-if forecast exports created using the CreateWhatIfForecastExport operation.

subcommands.name: list-what-if-forecasts
subcommands.description: Returns a list of what-if forecasts created using the CreateWhatIfForecast operation.

subcommands.name: resume-resource
subcommands.description: Resumes a stopped monitor resource.

subcommands.name: stop-resource
subcommands.description: Stops a resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the specified tags to a resource with the specified resourceArn.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Replaces the datasets in a dataset group with the specified datasets.
